about: Vehicle roster, ordered weakest to strongest: classes run scouts -> highway -> heavy-duty -> offroad -> heavy, and tiers inside a class rise in power, speed, capacity, wheels and load size. Every car carries its load as part of its art and mass (load): small loads on scouts up to huge loads on heavy haulers. Tires are fixed (wheelType, see wheel-types.json): to get something stronger, switch cars. Service trucks (fuel and repair, small to huge) are called in play for free: they winch a stuck truck free, refuel it or repair it; towMassT is the heaviest truck each can pull. status: playable (car.json and art exist), planned, needs-art.

classes.name: Scouts
classes.about: Light 4×4 explorers: fast and nimble, bed or roof loads only, small trailers.

classes.name: Highway
classes.about: Road tractors and haulers: quick and strong on firm roads, struggle off-road.

classes.name: Heavy Duty
classes.about: Work trucks for logging, construction and utilities: strong, geared low, decent off-road.

classes.name: Off-road
classes.about: All-terrain 6×6 and 8×8 trucks with huge tires: built for mud, water and rock.

classes.name: Heavy
classes.about: Huge prime movers and mining giants for oversize loads: slow, enormous torque, multi-axle trailers.
